stages.reference: Create a close material reference for lime-green stained glass tinted with old yellow-green mineral dye. Its color is lively but worn into a believable dark-fantasy world: softened chartreuse, slightly more golden in thin places and deeper green where the silica body is thick. The translucency should remain evident beneath modest hand-formed irregularity, never concealed by painterly pigment. Keep the surface calm and practical, neither jewel-like nor fluorescent. Subtle soft transmission matters more than crisp sparkle. Avoid grass patterns, slime, acid liquid, neon lighting, glossy gemstones, hard white reflections, excessive dirt, ornamental glass leading or opaque lime paint. Establish the quiet but distinctive parent glass material that its companion detail layer will inherit.
